describe.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile as a low, elongated quadruped with an arched back and a long, tapering tail extending to the left. Most of its dorsal, lateral, and tail surfaces are covered in large, overlapping, rounded scales that are dark brown with tan edges, interspersed with irregular patches of pale pink, lightly speckled skin. The underside, lower limbs, and head sides have wrinkled, gray-brown skin with fine whiskers at the muzzle. The head is narrow and pointed, ending in a rounded, pinkish nose, with a small dark eye. Behind the head and on the top of the head are prominent, fleshy pink stalks bearing fine, feathery, branching filaments. It stands on four short, sturdy limbs that end in broad, clawed feet.

describe.description: A stocky quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile walking on four short sturdy legs. Its back, sides, top of the head, upper legs and long tapering tail that extends to the left out of frame are covered in overlapping rounded brown scales, with patches of larger pale pink speckled scales on the mid-flank and shoulder. The head is elongated to a pointed blunt snout with a dark nostril at the tip, a small round black eye on the side, wrinkled tan-brown skin on the face, belly and lower legs, and broad clawed feet. Behind the head on the neck are six pink branched stalks with fine red feathery fringe, three projecting sideways from behind the cheek and three projecting upward from the top of the neck.
